task: Write test_cases.json only. It must be a JSON list of at least four distinct cases for solve(data) implementing the deep-merge contract. Each case has an input object with keys base and patch, plus exactly one of output (expected JSON result) or error (exception class name, e.g. ValueError). Optional name/notes fields are allowed. Cover: nested object merge (base {a:{x:1}}, patch {a:{y:2}} gives {a:{x:1,y:2}}); null removes a key and removing an absent key is a no-op; list replacement with no concatenation; boolean vs number type mismatch raises ValueError; non-object base or patch raises ValueError; key order (base order first, then patch-only keys in patch order). Expected values must follow the user contract exactly, not the current module.py behavior. Do not write module.py.
